matrixEncoding.description: Each state row is a complete 14-family matrix. Its defaultStatus applies to every family in familyOrder; overrides replace that cell for the named families. This avoids hiding unsupported states behind a generic 'covered' mark.
importantInterpretation: DEFAULT OBSERVED means a current specimen/example rendered; it does not imply every variant or transition was approved.
DYNAMICALLY EXERCISED means the named local Chromium state was actually attempted. It does not mean the state passed or was approved; row evidence must record both passes and failures.
INSPECTED SOURCE is not a runtime claim.
NOT PROVABLE identifies consumer-owned service/context behavior absent from this standalone UI kit; it is not an invented missing-backend defect.
NOT APPLICABLE means the named state is not a state owned by that family in this kit, not that a future consumer never needs it.

families.evidence: Credential specimen; invalid submit, password reveal, readonly/disabled, focus, and mobile geometry are dynamically exercised by local interaction/numeric suites.
Settings/layer example; view switch, back, close, naming, focus movement, and restoration are exercised by the interaction browser suite.
Variants and touch target geometry are observed; focus/disabled/boundary behavior is covered by the component/mobile and lifecycle suites where applicable.
Count 0/1/2/7, RTL, keyboard, pointer swipe, disclosure, boundaries, resize, disconnect, re-init, and long content have bounded dynamic evidence.

Chart geometry, large/unknown/negative values, long amount, resize, progress, reduced motion, and 23 same-node scale-state/error-recovery checks are exercised. The original data-scale suite was run with its --out override.
Field default/error/readonly/disabled/focus geometry, step boundaries, exact decimal/scientific values, long numeric input, and 200% representative stress are exercised by local suites.
Default variants and info-peek count, resize, drag-disconnect, re-init, hidden-reveal, and boundary lifecycle are covered; no service-backed loading/stale semantics are proven.
Static example and source contract inspected; consumer-supplied metrics are fixture content, not real account data.
Tabs, carousel keyboard boundaries, modal focus/inert/restoration, menu/layer examples, and 200% chart-mobile navigation geometry have bounded browser evidence.
Calendar/mobile contract has existing 55-pass/0-fail component-width and data-equivalence evidence; it does not establish service, timezone, or real-device behavior.
Static long labels, rows, disabled examples, and 672-character transient title stress are inspected/observed; actual permission or data service outcomes are not present.

Checkbox/radio/switch/segmented/picker examples; partial select, empty-search recovery, keyboard selection, long label, and 48 px label-wrapper unions are dynamically checked. The supported simulated async-error path reproduces INT-001 at all four tested widths; it is cross-referenced, not duplicated as an edge finding.
Default surface/curve specimens observed; no consumer theme variant was inferred.
Static success/warning/error/empty/skeleton specimens observed; long message and reduced-motion visibility are dynamically stressed; real service delivery is not implemented.

stateRows.trigger: Open a current component/example or preview route.
stateRows.recommendedTreatment: Present the component’s default state and retain its semantics; do not infer that a fixture equals a live user/account.
stateRows.evidence: 36 local HTML routes × four default widths = 144 screenshots; Arabic/RTL fixtures, no default document overflow, no page/resource errors.

stateRows.trigger: A consumer waits for or incrementally receives asynchronous data.
stateRows.recommendedTreatment: Keep usable partial content stable; use a semantically named skeleton/progress indicator only when the consumer can determine load status; avoid layout jumps and motion when reduced motion is requested.
stateRows.evidence: Messages route contains a static skeleton specimen and data route a progress example. These do not establish an initial/partial/slow service transition; no backend exists.

stateRows.trigger: A consumer collection has no records initially or becomes empty after removal.
stateRows.recommendedTreatment: Differentiate first-use guidance from an emptied collection; state why it is empty and offer only an action the consumer can actually perform.
stateRows.evidence: No live collection or deletion flow is defined by this UI kit; static empty-state copy does not prove consumer journey handling.

stateRows.trigger: A search/filter yields no matches.
stateRows.recommendedTreatment: Explain that the current query/filter has no matches and preserve a direct way to edit or clear it; keep it distinct from a first-time empty list.
stateRows.evidence: The picker no-results recovery and keyboard selection/summary are separate passing checks in the latest 88-check interaction run. That run has 84 PASS / 4 FAIL; all four failures are the distinct picker async-error INT-001 repeated at 320/360/390/430 px. A real filter data set or other-family no-results state was not exercised.

stateRows.trigger: A required or constrained value is invalid at blur/submit/change.
stateRows.recommendedTreatment: Keep the user value, associate concise corrective copy with the field, expose invalid state, and focus the first invalid control when submit is blocked.
stateRows.evidence: Interaction suite confirms access-gateway invalid submit, linked error, invalid flag, and first-invalid focus; lifecycle/component checks cover field error geometry and related state.

stateRows.trigger: A chart's declared maximum/total is invalid, below the data, or conflicts with its values.
stateRows.recommendedTreatment: Reject an unsafe relative visualization with concise user-facing copy; retain full readings; keep technical detail separate; clear stale diagnostics on valid recovery and recalculate on the same chart node.
stateRows.evidence: python3 tools/data-scale-state-check.py --out generated-artifacts/pixilated-audit/edge-tests/data-scale: 23/23 pass, covering invalid/over/rescaled/conflict transitions, recovery, event synchronization, and no JavaScript errors.

stateRows.trigger: A consumer service rejects or cannot complete a request.
stateRows.recommendedTreatment: Use a brief user-facing error, preserve entered data, provide a safe retry/recovery action, and keep technical diagnostics out of user copy.
stateRows.evidence: The message family has static error examples, but no network/server call exists to trigger, retry, or verify one.

states: Supported simulated asynchronous picker error state (not a real network result)
stateRows.trigger: A user has focused a picker option and the fixture invokes the component's supported non-ready error state.
stateRows.recommendedTreatment: Keep focus on a visible persistent target, move status feedback outside listbox option semantics, announce it with appropriate live status semantics, and keep retry operable.
stateRows.evidence: Latest interaction-browser-results.json: the assertion fails at 320/360/390/430 px RTL. At each width focusRetained=false and hasLiveAnnouncement=false; retryVisible=true and statusInsideListbox=true. This is one repeated interaction finding, INT-001, not four edge findings. No real network request occurred.

stateRows.trigger: A consumer authorization check fails or the session expires.
stateRows.recommendedTreatment: Explain the next allowed action without leaking protected content; preserve a safe return location after sign-in where product policy permits.
stateRows.evidence: Credential/settings/message specimens are presentation only; role, expiry, redirect, and session lifecycle are absent.

stateRows.trigger: A consumer action completes positively.
stateRows.recommendedTreatment: Provide concise confirmation with a stable/non-duplicated announcement; persistent feedback remains until dismissed/cleared according to its declared contract.
stateRows.evidence: The messages page displays static success/status examples; no real save operation or backend success is implied.

states: Disabled: waiting on prerequisite or boundary
stateRows.trigger: An action is unavailable because of a boundary, prerequisite, or readonly/disabled control.
stateRows.recommendedTreatment: Keep a visible disabled state, preserve keyboard/touch behavior, and expose a reason when users can resolve the prerequisite.
stateRows.evidence: Field step min/max/readonly/disabled boundaries, password reveal gating, carousel/info-peek count/boundary behavior, and keyboard focus were exercised. Selection/navigation show disabled examples.

stateRows.trigger: A content region is loading and its approximate geometry is known.
stateRows.recommendedTreatment: Keep the skeleton decorative to assistive technology unless it carries status; announce loading separately; stop shimmer under reduced motion.
stateRows.evidence: Messages skeleton is a static specimen and remains visible with zero running animations under reduced-motion emulation; it does not model async lifecycle.

states: Partial load / lazy load / pagination boundary
stateRows.trigger: Only part of a larger consumer data set is available or a page/slide boundary is reached.
stateRows.recommendedTreatment: Name current position and available next/previous actions; keep loading state distinct from a fully loaded last page; announce only meaningful position changes.
stateRows.evidence: Carousel/info-peek position, controls, counts, and navigation boundaries are exercised. These are local presentation/navigation boundaries, not lazy network pagination.

stateRows.trigger: Text or an amount exceeds its comfortable line/column width.
stateRows.recommendedTreatment: Prefer wrap and content growth for important names, values, and corrective copy; truncate only secondary text with an accessible full-value route.
stateRows.evidence: Transient 320 px probes used 72 digits, a 1,500-character message, a 672-character organization title, a 792-character carousel title, and a 672-character selection label; all grew vertically without horizontal overflow. Other families were source/default-reviewed, not stress-mutated.

stateRows.trigger: A consumer supplies the longest supported name, amount, count, unit, or chart value.
stateRows.recommendedTreatment: Define input limits/formatting at the contract boundary; preserve the exact value, wrap where meaningful, and provide an accessible full reading without hiding outliers.
stateRows.evidence: Long-value probes cover representative families; numeric-field-controls-check exercised very long numeric/non-arithmetic strings and exact decimal/scientific increments. No consumer-wide maximum policy exists.

stateRows.trigger: A consumer displays a value that may be older than its source.
stateRows.recommendedTreatment: Show provenance/last-updated context and a refresh or safe stale-data warning only when the consumer can establish freshness.
stateRows.evidence: Static labels and indicators do not carry cache timestamps or refresh semantics; no stale-data service is present.

states: Input default / hover / focus / active / filled / valid
stateRows.trigger: A user reaches, focuses, edits, or completes a supported control.
stateRows.recommendedTreatment: Keep labels and focus visible, retain native text editing/caret keys, communicate selection without color alone, and separate hover/active from persistent selected state.
stateRows.evidence: Field lifecycle, 48 px targets, native editing, keyboard navigation, focus visibility, carousel controls, tabs, picker, and password reveal have bounded Chromium tests. Account-settings view/layer focus is dynamically checked; other settings editing remains source-only.

states: Input error / real-time vs on-blur vs on-submit validation
stateRows.trigger: The chosen validation policy detects an invalid or missing value.
stateRows.recommendedTreatment: Choose timing per form and error cost; avoid interruptive validation while typing; associate and focus the corrective error at the declared decision point.
stateRows.evidence: Submit-error flow and field error geometry are exercised; the full range of live/on-blur/on-submit policies across all consumer forms is not proven.

stateRows.trigger: A control needs instructions, an example, or a bounded-length hint.
stateRows.recommendedTreatment: Keep a persistent programmatic label; connect help/error text; do not make placeholder the only label; show a count only when an actual maximum exists.
stateRows.evidence: Static examples are inspected/observed; a consumer character-limit contract is not implied.

stateRows.trigger: A value is unavailable for editing or an action is blocked.
stateRows.recommendedTreatment: Use native disabled/readonly semantics consistently; keep explanatory text separate from the value; do not silently mutate a disabled/readonly value.
stateRows.evidence: Selection wrappers include visible disabled cases; numeric and password tests exercise readonly/disabled gating. Hidden choice inputs are not their hit target: 12 label unions measured ≥48 px high.

stateRows.trigger: Identity, session, authorization, account policy, or step-up verification changes.
stateRows.recommendedTreatment: Set a consumer-owned state contract for access, safe recovery, return routing, and support; avoid suggesting successful authentication from a presentation-only credential specimen.
stateRows.evidence: No identity provider, session, roles, suspension policy, or 2FA integration exists; gateway layout and client-side invalid input are not actual auth.

stateRows.trigger: Connectivity or consumer write synchronization is interrupted.
stateRows.recommendedTreatment: Decide read/write queue and conflict policy in the future consumer; surface retry/sync state without discarding entered content or promising cached availability that is not implemented.
stateRows.evidence: This repository is a standalone UI kit with no network-backed workflow/cache; no real offline or synchronization state was fabricated.

stateRows.trigger: A route/component is rendered at a narrow viewport.
stateRows.recommendedTreatment: Keep primary reading order and controls usable; wrap important content; permit horizontal scrolling only for explicitly scrollable patterns.
stateRows.evidence: Every listed route was loaded at the four sweep widths; focused suites add touch/keyboard geometry. Default screenshots are observations; not physical-device checks.

stateRows.trigger: Viewport width/height or orientation changes.
stateRows.recommendedTreatment: Keep reading measure bounded and usable, remeasure responsive charts, and ensure layers/controls remain reachable without implying safe-area/device validation.
stateRows.evidence: All 36 routes were measured at 844×390 landscape; chart suite also resizes/re-measures SVG. No real device/safe-area check.

stateRows.trigger: The browser reports prefers-reduced-motion: reduce.
stateRows.recommendedTreatment: Remove nonessential transitions/shimmers while preserving state and progress information; keep state changes immediate and understandable.
stateRows.evidence: Browser media emulation was applied to all routes; direct message/data probes confirmed visible examples and zero running animations on those two pages. Not an OS/device test.

stateRows.trigger: The browser reports forced-colors: active.
stateRows.recommendedTreatment: Retain control boundaries, text, focus, and non-color state distinctions using system colors/visible geometry; test representative states with the target OS/browser before claiming support.
stateRows.evidence: Forced-colors emulation was applied to all 36 routes; representative showcase screenshot and computed visibility for button, input, note, and skeleton show visible content. Chromium emulation is not a real OS high-contrast session.

stateRows.trigger: A consumer/theme context requests a dark or reversed appearance.
stateRows.recommendedTreatment: Decide whether this system must expose a second semantic token context; if yes, design and validate surfaces, boundaries, focus, states, and data colors as a coherent variant rather than applying a global inversion.
stateRows.evidence: Current source demonstrates a single appearance contract. No dark mode was added or inferred; owner decides whether it is required before transfer.

stateRows.trigger: A consumer distinguishes a new account from a familiar one.
stateRows.recommendedTreatment: Design education/progressive disclosure only when product context and audience evidence support it; do not invent a journey or persona from fixture labels.
stateRows.evidence: No real users, analytics, product journey, or onboarding requirement exists in this repository.

states: Power user: keyboard shortcuts / bulk actions
stateRows.trigger: A consumer supports frequent keyboard operation or bulk selection.
stateRows.recommendedTreatment: Document shortcuts only when implemented; avoid intercepting native text-editing/IME/modified keys; provide a visible, reversible bulk-selection state.
stateRows.evidence: Keyboard focus, native caret/editing keys, carousel navigation, tabs, selection, password action, and account layer focus are covered by existing local suites. No product-wide shortcuts policy is proven.

stateRows.trigger: The consumer renders Arabic/RTL labels with numbers, Latin IDs, or mixed currency.
stateRows.recommendedTreatment: Use logical properties, preserve reading order, isolate mixed-direction values where required, and verify long copy under the actual target locale.
stateRows.evidence: All default route captures use Arabic RTL; interaction checks exercise representative RTL keyboard/swipe behavior. Browser locale ar-JO does not prove all locale formats.

stateRows.trigger: A consumer locale or timezone changes the display/interpretation of values.
stateRows.recommendedTreatment: Choose a single formatter/timezone ownership contract and test negative, zero, unknown, long, and mixed-script values; keep the full underlying value available.
stateRows.evidence: Fixture examples contain Arabic currency and dates as literal sample content; no locale-aware formatter or timezone data service is asserted.

broadSweep.textSizeSimulationLimit: Inline doubling of pre-snapshotted computed font sizes; not native zoom or OS dynamic type.

focusedSuites.artifact: Console output only; uses the already-running local preview.

interactionBrowser.failureName: picker async error preserves a visible local focus target and announces status
interactionBrowser.handling: Dynamically exercised means the state was run; this failure is explicitly not treated as approved. It is cross-referenced to the interaction track and not duplicated in edge-findings.json.

transientFixtureProbes.cases: Long numeric/message/organization/carousel/selection content injected into browser DOM only; no fixture or source file was written.
transientFixtureProbes.labelTargetUnion: 12 choice labels measured; every label hit area is at least 48 px high. Hidden native input is 1×1 by design.

limitations: No production service, auth, role, analytics, user journey, or real user data exists in the audited scope.
No real screen reader, physical device, native zoom, OS high-contrast mode, safe area, WebKit, or Firefox was tested.
The JSON reports demonstrated kit states and explicit unknowns; it does not propose implementing a product backend.
